trust_decision.summary: Sequential SAO sizes its scratch copy of the decoded plane from stream-controlled picture dimensions (stride*height*bpp); the size must not overflow before the allocation and memcpy in apply_sample_adaptive_offset_sequential. At the pinned commit this arithmetic is already done in size_t/ptrdiff_t. The listed fix commit does not touch SAO.

landing_point.why: The summary names the 'SAO sequential filter' and a signed overflow into a heap overflow; the only sequential SAO buffer sizing is the inputCopy allocation in apply_sample_adaptive_offset_sequential.

fix_sites.entry_point: none related to the advisory: a GCC '#pragma diagnostic ignored -Wmaybe-uninitialized' wrapped around ff_hevc_transform_32x32_add_8_sse4 (libde265/x86/sse-dct.cc). No behaviour change.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No published source fix for the SAO flaw exists in the diff, and the pinned SAO code already uses size_t/ptrdiff_t arithmetic, so a solver can correctly argue nothing is left to fix.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Revert the size_t cast so lumaImageSize/chromaImageSize are computed in int from stride*height*bpp.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This is very likely the pre-fix shape of the code; the casts look like a recent hardening (the git log shows bdca875 'fix pixel-accessor integer overflow on large frames'). Single-site, where-type only.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Per-row pointer offset xC+(yC+j)*stride narrowed to int in apply_sao_internal.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The stride is ptrdiff_t now (libde265/image.h:276); a maintainer could plausibly have used an int local for it. The same concept as the allocation, so it would fall together with it.

O9_family: integer overflow in buffer-size computation leading to heap buffer overflow (CWE-190 -> CWE-122)

O10_build.project_tests: unknown: no SAO-specific tests found in the pinned tree (glob **/*test*/**/*sao* returned nothing)

j.j_sites_touched: libde265/x86/sse-dct.cc (pragma only; unrelated to the advisory)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cast stride*height*bpp to size_t in apply_sample_adaptive_offset_sequential; this is already present at the pinned commit.

out_of_scope_notes: Candidate is mis-mapped: fix_commit 4dd701f only suppresses a GCC -Wmaybe-uninitialized warning in libde265/x86/sse-dct.cc and has no relation to SAO or integer overflow.

The real SAO fix probably predates the pinned commit (candidates: bdca875 'fix pixel-accessor integer overflow on large frames (GHSA-ccfw-29x7-rrx3)' or an earlier commit); re-screen against the correct fix/parent pair.
